azimuth_note: ODE supplies incidence, emission and phase but not solar azimuth, and azimuth cannot be derived from incidence: two scenes can share an incidence angle and be lit from opposite sides of noon. No azimuth band may be rewritten from this result.
ground_truth: none available; the accuracy measure is the perturbation gate's recovery of a known (3,4) px shift injected into the real source
